!Sample_description = A1
!Sample_description = processed data file: my_counts_anno_merged.txt
!Sample_data_processing = Library strategy: CRISPR Screen
!Sample_data_processing = 50 bp single reads were trimmed using cutadapt (version 1.16) by removing the adapter sequence (-g GGACGAAACACCG) and setting the read length to 20 bp (-l 20).
!Sample_data_processing = Trimmed reads were separately aligned to Human GeCKOv2 Library A or B using bowtie2 (version 2.3.4.1) with parameter --norc.
!Sample_data_processing = Aligned reads were filtered by samtools (version 1.7) using the parameter -q 2.
!Sample_data_processing = Reads were subsampled to 5 million reads with replacement and counted for each sgRNA, annotated with gene information and library A and B from the same sample were merged into a table.
